g.text: Sequence Diagram - VIS01 Engine Failure and Cleanup (renderer creation, module build, frame update/render, context loss)
Precondition: configuration valid and EVERY asset preloaded (sequence_diagram_open_viewer D2).
Asset download failures never reach the engine: they are the "error / asset-unavailable" state (D1).
On failure the engine calls dispose(). The viewer removes the canvas and shows Retry.
Cleanup continues after individual errors and can be called again safely.
no module created, loop never started
F2. A module build fails (sync throw or rejected Promise)
await engine.load(configuration, assets, [makeA, makeB, makeC], signal)
load() takes ownership of loadedAssets first
C is never created nor built
abort build controller; disconnect resize observer;
dispose() (must be safe after a partial build)
"The 3D viewer stopped because of an error."
F3. update() or render() throws during the render loop
start() (after a successful load of A, B, C)
(C, B, A disposed in reverse order)
reported ONCE; a frame callback already queued
render() throwing follows the same path (phase "render").
F4. WebGL context lost (driver reset, GPU memory pressure)
F5. Unmount or reload while a build is still pending
The effect assigns its local engine variable
When a dependency resolves late, the module
checks the signal and releases the result.
The aborted signal prevents the attempt
from starting the engine or updating the UI.
clean up; set loading; increment attempt
check WebGL; request configuration; preload assets
a canvas after forceContextLoss() is never reused;
the fresh canvas receives a new WebGL context
